about: woman_stair-made's outfit as sewn clothes (#225): the tee and the skirt her close-up shows (work/pixal/woman_stair-made-s1.svviews/input.png: a pink short-sleeved tee worn over a grey A-line skirt to mid-calf), each a GarmentCode design (assets/design_params at the pinned commit) with the settings named, and each with a score_lib surface. The library holds no pink cotton: the tee wears the library's red cotton. Both cottons are the cloth recipe's cotton row in data/physics/cloth.json (the library's adopted NVIDIA cottons carry no recipe of their own). The body wears the library's skin_light. The tee's sleeves are cut loose (sleeve.connecting_width 0.6, GarmentCode's 0.2 sat 9% stretched round her upper arms and the walking arms dragged the tee off a shoulder, 2026-11-24). Her shoes and belt (#228): the library holds no shoe or belt model, so both are fitted on her (tools/characters/accessories): black leather shoes on white foam soles, a glossy black leather belt over the skirt's waistband with a polished brass buckle, each a score_lib surface (NVIDIA SimReady, CC BY 4.0).
